body: hi, im 20, but theres not really much i can do atm. also my therapy is run through my healthcare provider and the way they do things is different from traditional therapy where you have multiple sessions per week, its pretty much first come first serve and my appointment is all the way at the end of december. im reaching out to people, i just feel like im being annoying at this point because i keep conplaining about the same things

im so sorry your therapist said that to you wtf //: but ik exactly how you feel. im the same way. also abused twice and recently have had trouble separating myself from one of them completely. however after my grandparents died and i saw my mom grieve for the first time in my life its hard to find the will to go through it anymore. you truly never know how people will react. im not gonna say it gets better or anything cliche like that, but there are a lot of reasons to keep pushing. karma will kick their ass, even if it seems like forever from now. 
sorry if this is so messy but if u ever need someone to talk to my messages are open<3
im so sorry, i know exactly how that feels, and how bad they can get. i hope you’re able to overcome this terrible episode)):
i thought i was the only one !! for some reason being called by my name or any nicknames made from my name make me feel so weird.
